prerequisites.title: Kintone domain with admin access
prerequisites.detail: Clients are added in User & System Administration, so you need an administrator in the domain.

prerequisites.title: Callback URL from Composio
prerequisites.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard; Kintone requires a redirect endpoint.

steps.title: Register OAuth client in Kintone
steps.detail: Go to gear icon, User & System Administration, OAuth, Add OAuth Client. Enter client name and redirect endpoint, then save.
steps.done_when: Client ID and secret are shown.

steps.title: Grant users access to the client
steps.detail: Use Configure users to tick each user who may use the client.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a Composio auth config for kintone_rest with your client ID and secret and the scopes you need, space-separated.

steps.title: Connect a test user
steps.detail: Complete the Kintone consent page as a user who has been enabled.

traps.title: New users are disabled by default
traps.detail: Newly registered clients and newly created users have the client disabled until an admin ticks the checkbox.

traps.title: IP restrictions block OAuth
traps.detail: Domains with IP restrictions cannot use OAuth clients unless the client's IP is whitelisted.

traps.title: Short-lived access tokens
traps.detail: Access tokens last 1 hour and authorization codes 10 minutes; refresh tokens do not expire.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: The redirect_uri in the token request must equal the one used in the authorization request, and be URL-encoded.

blockers.what_it_means: The client is not enabled for that user in Configure users.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask a domain admin to tick the user's checkbox.
